routes.name: Common-witness reconstruction and factorial full-profile summation
Direct iteration of separate single-scale selectors
routes.retired_because: Separate existential members do not give a common member; Pham arXiv:2412.03540v1 Section 2.1 identifies loss of control under iteration.

C9000175.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 175 (Talagrand’s expectation thresholds, discrete convexity, and graph decompositions.; papers: Graph Decompositions at the Integral Expectation Threshold; Integral and fractional expectation thresholds are equivalent; Talagrand’s discrete-convexity conjecture; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/175.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

SCOPE_PRIOR175.statement: Scoped primary-source antecedents only; no external selector theorem or companion manuscript is assumed.

SEL175.statement: Original multiscale selector theorem, at all stated quantifiers, including one member for every scale.

SEL_TRUNC.statement: Largest admissible cutoff exists and has high-weight count at most m/d, with zero weights, ties and endpoints allowed.

SEL_MIN_COVER.statement: Minimum feasible moves exist, cover the family, and have nonempty changed sets on bad colorings.

SEL_RECON.statement: Final coloring plus full crossing profile determine common feasible witnesses; one-level delay forces every changed vertex into the common high-weight set.

SEL_COUNT.statement: Injective full-profile encoding and exact product-probability likelihood identity.

SEL_PROB.statement: The original rowwise entropy and profile summation imply bad probability at most 1/10.

SEL_CORE175.statement: Universal Lean reconstruction theorem derives shared-profile witness transport and strict high-weight membership from the actual feasibility tests and unrestricted-witness minimum length.

SEL_FACTORIAL175.statement: Factorial full-profile summation and the universal coefficient/geometric majorant.

SEL_GENERAL175.statement: For arbitrary positive palette and deficits, (1/2)Pr(bad)<=sum_{t=1}^{|X|}(t^t/t!)R^t, hence Pr(bad)<=2R/(1-3R) if 3R<1.

SEL_IMPROVED175.statement: The original selector holds with D=48; at the stated D=256 its success probability is at least 61/62, including s=0.

THRESH_IMPROVED175.statement: The same-budget threshold-rounding constant improves to 25*96^4.

THRESH_ROUND175.statement: Selector-to-rounding expectation contradiction, including nonempty set normalization and empty-set fractional mass.

THRESH_MAIN175.statement: Integral and fractional expectation thresholds differ by at most 25*512^4 with the same budget.

DC_COVER175.statement: The uniform-family covering lemma of the companion discrete-convexity manuscript; unverified.

DC_SIGNED175.statement: Biased Parseval bound, signed 32-row identity and exceptional weight bound; unverified.

DC_HALF175.statement: Measure at least 1/2 implies E_32 is (q/2^70)-small; unverified.

DC_DENSITY175.statement: Exclusive-label and mandatory-row couplings upgrade half-density smallness to same-density smallness; unverified.

DC_MAIN175.statement: At k=2^75, mu_p(D)>=1-1/k implies E_k(D) p-small; unresolved companion theorem, not an assumption.

GRAPH_TYPICAL175.statement: Above q(H;n), a high-density graph family has a union of 2^75 members containing H; conditional on the unresolved discrete-convexity theorem.

GRAPH_ELEMENTARY175.statement: Lower bounds on q, subgraph monotonicity and degeneracy edge splitting; unverified within this mission.

GRAPH_COMPRESS175.statement: Finite compressed smoothed tests for bounded-size neighborhood families; unverified.

GRAPH_TRANSFER175.statement: Simultaneous neighborhood transfer via compressed source and target tests and Hall's criterion; unverified.

GRAPH_STARS175.statement: Star-forest embedding at a constant multiple of q; unverified.

GRAPH_MAIN175.statement: Deterministic constant-size edge partition at the integral expectation threshold; unresolved.
